data: ‘Mere non-recovery, gravity of offence no ground to cancel anticipatory bail’: HC draws sharp line between ‘cancellation’ and ‘challenge’

The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ruled that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely on the ground of non-recovery of stolen articles or the seriousness of allegations.
